messages.subject: Interactivity with ggplot and base graphs/Development version of shiny/Typos in shiny-example # 095
parts:
Hi,

I am just exploring the new features in the development version of shiny....

Hovering, clicking, brushing on base and ggplot graphs... just great! Congratulations, I am curious to see these features in shiny on CRAN.

There might be two minor typos in the example I used for my "exploration" (https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-examples/tree/master/095-plot-interaction-advanced)

res <- nearPoints(dat, input$plot_click, xvar(), yvar(),
threshold = input$max_distance, maxrows = input$max_rows,
addDist = TRUE)
maxrows should be renamed in the example, the correct name (in my setup) is maxpoints

if (nrow(res) > 0)
res$`_dist` <- round(res$`_dist`, 1)
res$'_dist' should be read as res$dist_

Once again... great !! Thank you very much for all your efforts!

Best regards,

Jürgen
